{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Includes only a release note (doc/release-notes-34132.md) accompanying the code changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note additions for a code PR do not make it a documentation change."
    },
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/index/base.cpp, src/index/txindex.cpp, and secondary index implementations to make lookup and consistency failures fatal.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The change makes txindex lookup and consistency failures fatal rather than allowing corrupted indexes to fail individual RPC requests while the node continues running with damaged storage. This substantially alters data integrity and error handling semantics across the optional index framework."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/kernel/notifications_interface.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h to route fatal database read failures through the kernel notifications interface.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Routing database failures directly to fatal aborts through the notifications interface substantively alters error propagation and abort semantics for kernel library consumers. Reviewers noted that aborting inside read functions directly impacts host applications using the kernel."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h are two-line mechanical adjustments following coin view method changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect mempool or policy logic; edits are mechanical call-site updates."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "A single-line change in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp merely follows the updated index lookup method signature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR alters internal database error reporting rather than the RPC interface or transport itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in test/functional/test_framework/ and test harnesses merely support testing the specific database abort behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test framework and fuzz harness edits pin the behavior of database read errors and belong to those respective subsystems."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "CDBWrapper and LevelDB are validation storage infrastructure, and changes to src/init.cpp simply remove unused catcher views.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Database storage wrappers and initialization tie-ins belong to validation rather than general utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled 'UTXO Db and Indexes' and modifies src/coins.cpp, src/coins.h, src/txdb.cpp, and src/dbwrapper.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "CDBWrapper::Read() previously returned false on deserialization failures, masking database corruption as missing keys and throwing catchable exceptions. Resolving this improves chainstate corruption handling and removes the CCoinsViewErrorCatcher indirection layer."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
